content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (EXCLUSIVITY), high severity.**

- **Where:** § 3(i) Credit Bureau Information (p0042). No express "exclusivity" clause exists, and § 2(a) helpfully confirms Client may acquire or develop competing software/services. But § 3(i) buries a requirements commitment: Client "shall order TrueLink a credit report on each borrower for which an underwriting approval is requested through a System using the Interface."
- **Why it fails fallback:** the sole-source commitment runs for the whole term (no 12-month cap) and has no automatic termination on TrueLink's failure to meet service levels (§ 3(b) response times, § 3(d) availability) or delivery dates — i.e. exclusive dealing with no performance-based exit.
- **Cure (preferred level, single surgical edit):** "shall order TrueLink a credit report on each borrower" → "may order from TrueLink a credit report on any borrower", leaving TrueLink's transmission obligation and the following disclaimer untouched. Redline validated (ok:true, minimality passed).
